newsitem.title: USA: Student hostages released on Colorado campus.
newsitem.headline: Student hostages released on Colorado campus.

text.p: Three women students at the University of Northern Colorado who were taken hostage on Tuesday by an armed man were released, a university spokesman said.
"The situation is over. The hostages are safe. The gunman was wounded," said Tom Barbour, spokesman for the university which is located in Greeley, about 55 miles north of Denver.
The unidentified gunman, who was believed to be a former boyfriend of one of the students was taken to a local hospital, Barbour said.
A fourth female student who had been in the dormitory room when the gunman entered got out earlier, Barbour said, although he did not have details on how she was able to escape.
Students in the dormitory had been evacuated.
